title: Tag and Push to ghcr.io
description: Tag the local image with the GitHub Container Registry path twice, then push both the latest tag and the version tag.

steps.description: These commands tag and push the image to GitHub Container Registry. The page says to tag the image with the registry path, then push both a version tag and `latest`.
The two `docker tag` commands label the local image with the registry path, once as `latest` and once as `0.1.0`.
The two `docker push` commands upload both tags. The page notes that ghcr.io is free for public images and needs no separate Docker Hub account.
